dag.order_fixed: No fixed order. Partial order via DAG; e2e_config.yaml dag_unlock.early_unblock=true, ignore_weak_dependencies=true; strong deps block, downstream unlocks on submission

setup: python -m harness.e2e.run_e2e ... ; python -m harness.e2e.run_milestone ...; python -m harness.e2e.collect_results --workspace-root ... --trials T --trial-type e2e; python -m harness.e2e.evaluator ...
evaluator.submission: agent creates git tags agent-impl-milestone_NNN in persistent container /testbed; watcher snapshots and runs tests in a separate one-time evaluation container
evaluator.workspace_carryover: yes, single persistent container, no reset
evaluator.images: DockerHub hyd2apse/swe-milestone__<repo>__<milestone>:<version>; navidrome base amd64 linux compressed 795013205 bytes
evaluator.network: iptables outbound whitelist in agent container; GitHub/GitLab blocked; --pull=never
evaluator.resources: eval container --cpus default 16, no --memory limit; no disk/RAM requirement stated
evaluator.os: Linux docker amd64 images; Windows not documented

metrics.per_milestone: Recall=N_fixed/N_target (F2P+N2P); Precision=(N_fixed+1)/(N_fixed+N_broken+1), N_broken=P2P failed+missing; Score=2PR/(P+R) (harness/e2e/collect_results.py calculate_score_reliable); infra-invalid/build fail=0; aggregate mean over graded milestones

site_text.scored: Each milestone is scored on a precision-recall structure over its own tests: recall credits the fail-to-pass tests (F2P) the agent gets passing, precision credits the previously-passing tests (P2P) it keeps intact. A milestone counts as fully resolved only when every F2P passes and no P2P regresses, penalizing both under-building and regressions.

paper_5_1.score: the harmonic mean of Recall and Precision
paper_5_1.resolve: a milestone is considered resolved only if the agent passes all associated F2P and P2P tests
